803981.desc: Create stalactites that strike your enemy 2001 times, dealing 40686.333 Physical damage over 1 sec. Generates 2 stacks of Earthshaping. and 20 Rage. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells.

804002.name: Geode
804002.desc: Hurl an enchanted stone at the target, dealing 173 Physical Damage and generating 5 Rage.

804034.name: Forgemaster Strike
804034.desc: You strike an enemy target, dealing 114.96 to 117.96 Physical Damage.

804124.name: Thane's Rage
804124.desc: Increases your attack power by 20% of your Stamina and your Stamina by 10% of your Strength for 15 sec.

804180.name: Animal Companions (DEPRECATED)
804180.desc: Boons now instead summon a permanent spirit pet based on the Boon used to aid you in combat. Boons now also have a 30 sec cooldown and cost no rage. The pets mimic your Primal Charge ability, and scale with Strength. Only 1 Spirit can be active at a time.

804433.name: Seismic Spike
804433.desc: Bring forth a massive stalagmite from the ground beneath an enemy and up to 6 nearby enemies, dealing 172 Physical damage. Generates 4 Rage for each target struck. Generates 1 Earthshaping. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells.

804664.name: Fae Dust
804664.desc: Sprinkle an ally with Fae Dust, increasing their stealth detection and reducing all Nature and Arcane damage they take by 3%. Lasts 15 min.

804705.name: Ring of Life
804705.desc: Allies within 40 yds receive 6% increased healing. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, your Magic Damage taken is reduced by -10%.

804741.name: Dreamway: Seradane
804741.desc: Teleport to Seradane in The Hinterlands.

804742.name: Dreamway: The Twilight Grove
804742.desc: Teleport to The Twilight Grove in Duskwood.

804743.name: Dreamway: Dream Bough
804743.desc: Teleport to Dream Bough in Feralas.

804744.name: Dreamway: Bough Shadow
804744.desc: Teleport to Bough Shadow in Ashenvale.

804991.name: Stone Tossing
804991.desc: Gives Physical Damage dealt a 10% chance to grant Groundshaker.

805105.name: Ancient of Lore
805105.desc: Funnel nature's energies into yourself, transforming into an Ancient of Lore for 20 seconds. While active, your stats are increased by 20% and nearby party members have their costs reduced by -30%.

805107.name: Earthmother's Binding
805107.desc: Envelop a target in the Earthmother's love, healing them for 661 + 100% healing + 100% AP. If used on an ally, 30% of their damage taken is redirected to you for 6 seconds.

805108.name: Wildmend
805108.desc: Heals an ally for 354 to 361, scaling with your attack power and healing spell power. Any effects that impact your Ruptured Earth ability also affect this spell.

805335.name: Golem Form
805335.desc: Transform into a being made of stone and earth for 20 seconds, increasing your haste by 20% and your Armor by 50%, and allowing you to cast damaging spells while moving.

805442.name: Flourishing Growth
805442.desc: Empower party and raid members within 40 yds with verdant strength, increasing their attack or spell power by 95 for 20 seconds. Does not stack with similar effects.

805443.name: Grovekeeper's Presence
805443.desc: Increases chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% for you and party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects.

805445.name: Shaman Training
805445.desc: Damage dealt by Wildclaw now reduces the enemy's armor by 555 for 8 seconds.

805462.name: Seismic Wave
805462.desc: Create a seismic wave of healing water around you, healing for 32 + 60% healing + 28% AP health to up to 8 allies and dealing 54 + 28% AP + 30% healing Nature Damage to enemies in a 25 yd radius.

805634.name: Tectonic Shield
805634.desc: Gives successful blocks a 35% chance to remove a stack of Tectonic Shift.

805643.name: Mountain Mover
805643.desc: Avoiding an attack grants a stack of Mountain Mover for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times. Wildclaw consumes Mountain Mover stacks to cost -10% less Rage per stack.

805646.name: Earthen Blast
805646.desc: Instantly deals 388 to 393 Nature Damage to nearby enemies.

805867.name: Dreamslip
805867.desc: Shifts a party member into the Emerald Dream for 15 seconds, making them immune to damage and unable to attack or cast spells. While active, the target quickly regenerates health and mana and cannot be seen by other players or creatures. Cannot be used on self.

805874.name: Mountain's Might
805874.desc: Your next Stoneslam generates 40% more Rage and deals 40% additional damage. At 5 stacks, Stoneslam is further empowered by 150%.

805920.name: Bronzeheart
805920.desc: Increases the chance for healing received to remove a stack of Tectonic Shift by 20%.

805930.name: Knifetwirler
805930.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your ability by 3%, but increases its Rage cost by 2.

805943.name: Primal Spirit: Bear deprecated
805943.desc: Summons the Spirit of the Bear, capable of dealing damage to multiple enemies at once. Lasts 1 sec.

805944.name: Primal Spirit: Hawk
805944.desc: Summons the Spirit of the Bear for 0.

805945.name: Primal Spirit: Wolf deprecated
805945.desc: Summons the Spirit of the Wolf to shred enemies apart, dealing massive bleed damage. Lasts 1 sec.

805946.name: Primal Spirit: Turtle
805946.desc: Summons the Spirit of the Bear for 0.

805947.name: Primal Spirit: Tiger
805947.desc: Summons the Spirit of the Bear for -0.001 sec.

806143.name: Earth's Embrace
806143.desc: Encapsulate your body in amber, becoming immune to all Physical attacks and spells for 8 seconds, and healing you for 358 + 50% SP every 2 sec, but making you unable to move or act. Usable while stunned, feared, or polymorphed.

806185.name: Mountain Fury
806185.desc: Move the earth, dealing 502 + 65% SP + 17% AP + 125% Stamina Physical Damage to up to 12 enemies in a 10 yd frontal cone, pulling them toward you, repeating every 2 sec for 4 seconds. Each time an enemy is pulled toward you, you gain -2% reduced damage taken for 3 seconds, stacking 5 times.

806379.name: Primal Spirit: Elemental
806379.desc: Summons the Spirit of Earth for -0.001 sec.

806415.name: Bramblepatch
806415.desc: Grow a patch of brambles at your location for 12 seconds. Allies in the area are immune to grip and knockback effects. Enemies in the area are unable to leap, dash, or charge.

806533.name: Keen Senses
806533.desc: Increases your critical strike chance and haste by 3%.

806536.name: Primordial Earth
806536.desc: Critical strikes with melee attacks now summon 1 Spirit of Life that immediately casts a lesser Spirit Charge on a nearby ally, healing them for 397 + 20% nature SP + 20% AP and dealing 404 + 20% nature SP + 20% AP Nature Damage to nearby enemies.

806545.name: Hurl Geode
806545.desc: You hurl an enchanted stone at the target and up to 5 additional nearby enemies, dealing 99 Nature Damage, deals 20% increased damage for each enemy hit. Damage dealt reduces the cooldown of Earthquake by 2 sec.

806546.name: Swoop
806546.desc: Swoop an enemy, flying to their position and knocking them down. Rooting the target for 3 sec, disabling movement abilities.

806549.name: Savage Frenzy
806549.desc: Enrage you and your pet for 18 seconds, increasing damage dealt by 20%, and attack speed and movement speed by 30%.

806550.name: Stalk
806550.desc: The tiger and the Primalist begin stalking for 10 sec, reducing the chance that ranged attacks and spells will hit them by 70%, and increasing their movement speed by 40%. Dealing direct damage will end this effect. When this effect does end, both the Primalist and their pet gain 25% increased attack speed for 10 sec.

806551.name: Wildaxe
806551.desc: Strike an enemy, dealing 120 Physical damage with both weapons, and causing a special effect based on your active pet. Dealing direct Physical damage reduces the remaining cooldown of this ability by 2 sec.

806556.name: Pridelord
806556.desc: Dealing direct Physical Damage reduces the remaining Cooldown of your Wildaxe ability by 2 sec.

806559.name: Rexxar's Might
806559.desc: Your physical critical strikes now cause your pet's next attack to apply a bleed, dealing 93 + 15% AP Physical Damage every 2 sec for 6 seconds.

806569.name: Shred
806569.desc: Claw an enemy, causing them to bleed for 143 Physical Damage every 2 for 12 sec. While active, melee attacks against the target have 3% increased critical strike chance.

806570.name: Bear Spirit's Slam
806570.desc: The Spirit of the Bear deals 98 to 100 Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocks them into the air.

806571.name: Stalker's Pride
806571.desc: The Spirit of the Tiger gains 25% increased Melee Attack Speed for 10 sec, and grants the same bonus to you.

806572.name: Tiger Spirit's Fury
806572.desc: You and the Spirit of the Tiger enrage for 10 sec, causing direct Physical Damage done to deal additional Physical Damage.

806573.name: Hawk Spirit's Call
806573.desc: The Spirit of the Hawk heals you for 15% of your maximum health and restores 10% missing mana to all nearby allies.

806575.name: Elemental Spirit's Power
806575.desc: Rupture the earth beneath your enemies, doing 231 Nature Damage to 8 enemies within 6 yds.

806576.name: Wolf Spirit's Claw
806576.desc: The Spirit of the Wolf claws nearby enemies, causing them to bleed for 0 Physical Damage over 22 sec.

806577.name: Earthfury
806577.desc: Increases the Spirit of Earth's haste and damage dealt by 15% for 15 sec.

806584.name: Deprecatino
806584.desc: Reduces the shared Cooldown of your Primal Weapon abilities by 0.006 sec. In addition, activating a Primal Weapon ability now grants you a stack of Elemental Berserker for 0. When you reach 3 stacks of Elemental Berserker, your next Stoneslam becomes empowered with a bonus effect depending on the last Primal Weapon you activated. Earth: Knocks the target away and grants you a damage absorbtion shield. Life: Heals all nearby allies for a significant amount. Fire: Blasts the target for massive Fire damage. If the target is Bleeding, they take additional Fire damage. Lightning: Call down bolts of Lightning on all nearby enemies, dealing massive Nature Damage. Enemies take further increased damage from this effect for each stack of Stormshock on them.

807432.name: Seismic Grasp
807432.desc: Form mud and debris beneath an enemy, dismounting them, and slowing their movement speed by 50% over 10 sec. Generates 1 Earthshaping. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells.

807466.name: Nature's Blessing
807466.desc: Healing allies with Seismic Wave now heals them for an additional 20% of the healing done every 3 sec for 9 sec.

807558.name: Douse
807558.desc: Striking an enemy with Seismic spells now deals an additional 1 + 8% AP Frost Damage and reduces all resistances by 75 and increases their Magic Damage taken by -2% for 10 seconds.

807560.name: Primal Awakening
807560.desc: Enrage all nearby allies, increasing their haste by 30% for 20 seconds. After being affected by this spell, allies cannot benefit from similar effects for 5 minutes.

807565.name: Cursed Blood
807565.desc: Curse an enemy, reducing all resistances by -111.666 for 10 sec. Can only have 1 Jinx active on a target at a time.

807734.name: Heart of the Mountain
807734.desc: Therazane favors you, increasing your threat generated by 125%.

807753.name: Starstrike
807753.desc: Curse an enemy, reducing all resistances by -111.666 for 10 sec. Can only have 1 Jinx active on a target at a time.

809937.name: Dreamway: Twilight Grove
809937.desc: Creates a Dreamway to Bough Shadow in Duskwood, allowing party and raid members to teleport there. Lasts 1 min.

887019.desc: Tuning aura for Primalist Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887084.desc: Tuning aura for Primalist - Wildwalker. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887085.desc: Tuning aura for Primalist - Mountain King. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887086.desc: Tuning aura for Primalist - Geomancy. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887087.name: CoA Aura - Primalist - Grovekeeper
887087.desc: Tuning aura for Primalist - Grovekeeper. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

926597.name: Lesser Primal Wave
926597.desc: Restores 24 health to allies in a 12 yd cone, increasing magic resistances by 43 for 8 sec. Scales with attack power and healing spell power. Increases the attack power of affected allies by 50% for 8 sec.

991349.name: Monolith Smash
991349.desc: Stuns an enemy for 3 sec and Interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

991352.name: Rock Barrage
991352.desc: Fling a stone Geode at an enemy every 0.5 sec for 1 sec, each dealing 126 to 127 Nature Damage and generating 30 to 80 Rage.

991374.name: Stone Barrage
991374.desc: Fling a stone Geode at an enemy every 0.5 sec for 1 sec, each dealing 126 to 127 Nature Damage and generating 30 to 80 Rage.
